question: Are applicable effluent limitations, monitoring requirements, and other conditions for the authorized discharge determined solely from Part I–IV of farmington/final_permit.pdf (as incorporated by the cover authorization clause), or do the related statement-of-basis and fact-sheet locators bundled in the passage also supply governing permit terms for the same computation scope?
semantic_arguments: The cover authorization incorporates conditions 'set forth in Part I, Part II, Part III, and Part IV hereof' and names only City of Farmington under NPDES Permit No. NM0020583.
The passage presents separate related document locators for farmington/statement_of_basis.pdf, aztec/statement_of_basis.pdf, and gcc/fact_sheet.pdf in proximity to the primary cover span.
Purpose A requires identifying which enforceable numeric limits apply per facility, discharge point, and parameter.
Purpose B requires determining which monitoring requirements and conditional permit obligations were applicable.
Purpose C requires classifying missing-evidence and no-data states according to what the available permit evidence establishes.
notes: Different readings of whether the related locators are incorporated permit terms versus contextual cross-references would change which facilities and document sources enter the FY2025 applicability analysis. This obligation is formulated but not resolved.
